This is my first blog post. I am a geospatial and agronomy 
researcher at ICAR-CCARI, Goa. I created this portfolio to 
share my research journey, field notes, and short observations 
that don't fit into a formal research paper.

Stay tuned for posts on remote sensing, coastal agriculture, 
and soil health monitoring.
